projects.title: BBCincorp
description: Performance Optimization: Achieve High Performance for 100% Pages with the Pagespeed Insight Tool. Build a company formation website with 400 pages using Nextjs and TailwindCSS
Technology Used : NextJS, Atomic Design, React Bootstrap
projects.content:
Project Overview

BBCincorp is a comprehensive company formation platform serving multiple markets. This project involved building a high-performance website with 400+ pages optimized for speed and SEO.

Key Achievements

  • Achieved 100% high performance score on Pagespeed Insight
  • Built 400+ pages with Next.js and TailwindCSS
  • Implemented Atomic Design methodology
  • Optimized for multiple international markets

Technologies

NextJS, Atomic Design, React Bootstrap, TailwindCSS
